source: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2016 training sets a–f (Liu et al., Physiol Meas 2016, doi 10.1088/0967-3334/37/12/2181), ODC-By 1.0

all.what: MITHSDB — valve prolapse, benign murmurs, aortic disease
AUTHHSDB — aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation (echo-confirmed, ~75 y)

goodQuality.what: MITHSDB — valve prolapse, benign murmurs, aortic disease
AUTHHSDB — aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation (echo-confirmed, ~75 y)

ecg.rule: heart rate: ICC(2,1) ≥ 0.90 and |bias| ≤ 3 bpm; RMSSD: ICC(2,1) ≥ 0.75 and |bias| ≤ 10 ms
